timing_basis: Monotonic wall time from first camera snapshot through >=0.5s verified retention
wall_pacing: Each 480 Hz control step advances two 960 Hz PhysX substeps and takes at least 1/480 s wall time; no catch-up fast-forward
native_force_hold: Scattered controller: single motor + coupled passive finger, velocity preload, finite force; no attachment

CPU_fast_kinematics.algorithm: Same USD frames, joint bounds, DLS damping and 220-iteration limit; Eigen C++ implementation

pin_method: Tail grasp, uninterrupted axial insertion, release only after fresh full-depth RGB-D confirmation

randomized_bin_config.timing_metadata_correction: Parallel CPU reliability experiment; measured wall time is not an eligible optimization comparison.

clamp_control: Finite-force open/close commands, same jaw strokes and force caps
reference_motion: live RGB-D scattered controller; no taught pickup path

pin_collision_approximation.model: Four coaxial convex cylinders, approximate CAD outer dimensions

loose_stock_contact_policy: Fingertip nudging allowed; RGB-D palm sweep, fixed-structure queries and all physical contacts retained
motor_velocity_cap_policy: Signed position-dependent FR3 bounds at encoder position plus one-step margin; 93% drive cap and unchanged 95% actual velocity acceptance
native_gripper_control: One scalar width/velocity command + hard mechanical coupling; same reference on both pads; total effort cap 60.0 N and total damping 4000 N s/m, distributed equally; no additional motor capability; loaded grasp maintains closing force at 15 mm/s velocity preload instead of relaxing at a fixed minimum width; configured loaded preload 7.5 mm/s with 0.3 s force ramp

installation.backend: conservative full-CAD FCL acceptance + original PhysX fallback

certificate_stats.backend: conservative full-CAD FCL acceptance + original PhysX fallback

right.backend: FCL CPU proposals + live PhysX verification

left.backend: FCL CPU proposals + live PhysX verification

encoder_motor_speed_audit.velocity_cap_basis: 93% of conservative position-dependent bounds with one control-step lookahead; 95% acceptance reserve
